route: /style-board/ (the style board: module cta:image-band, longest and shortest copy, photos as grey frames)

findings.issue: This was flagged in the last review and is still not fixed: at both samples the photo band sits about 20 px in from the screen edge on each side, so it reads as a boxed panel inside the content gutter, not a closing band across the full width.
findings.reference: On home 17 the competitor's closing image band runs from edge to edge of the 1440 px viewport with no side margin. Its copy keeps to the content's left edge.
findings.fix: In reference.css, make `.block--cta[data-variant="image-band"] .cta` full-bleed: `margin-inline: calc(50% - 50vw); width: 100vw; border-radius: 0`. Keep `.cta__content`'s inline padding at the container gutter so the heading still starts on the content's left edge.

findings.issue: This was flagged in the last review and is still not fixed: at 390 px the band is inset by the gutter on both sides and lines up with the FAQ list above it, so it looks like a dark card rather than a full-width photo band.
findings.reference: At 390 px the competitor's closing band fills the screen from edge to edge.
findings.fix: Use the same full-bleed rule on `.block--cta[data-variant="image-band"] .cta` at every width (`margin-inline: calc(50% - 50vw); width: 100vw`) and keep the gutter as `.cta__content`'s padding.

findings.issue: This is still the case: in the longest sample the button label 'TALK TO US ABOUT SWIMWEAR PACKAGING & CUSTOM BRAND LABELS' wraps to three centred lines. That turns the full-width pill into a tall slab almost as heavy as the paragraph above it, which goes against reference.css's own aim of 'its label on one line'.
findings.reference: The competitor's band buttons carry one to three words each (BOOK A CALL-BACK, WHATSAPP, VISIT US, EMAIL US), so each one stays a single-line pill on phones.
findings.fix: In Site Factory, shorten this CTA's button label to a few words (for example 'Request a label quote') and leave the topic to the heading.

findings.issue: The copy is centred top to bottom in the band (heading to button runs from about 29% to 72% of its height), while the competitor's copy sits low in the band.
findings.reference: On home 17 the competitor's eyebrow, h2, paragraph and buttons run from about 43% to 83% of the band's height. The upper part of the photo is left clear and the copy rests above the lower edge.
findings.fix: In reference.css at min-width 1024px, set `[data-variant="image-band"] .cta` to align its content to the end (`align-items: flex-end`, or `align-self: end` on `.cta__content`). Give it a bottom padding of about 15% of the band height (`padding-block-end: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 6rem)`). Leave the min-height as it is.
